value.rationale: Provides a sharp and natural sqrt(k) late-start expected neighboring-hit law for a nonstationary mean-reverting random walk and proves a specifically conjectured finite mean for a Friedman opposite-reinforcement urn. The time dependence makes the geometric-count excursion sum nontrivial. Exact mean for the initial urn and higher-dimensional cases remain open.
